subject.title: WeCom（企业微信）发送消息后 agent 无响应

question: Is the current no-response report enough to route as an external WeCom plugin bug, or should maintainers first request a redacted live group-turn trace with OpenClaw version, plugin version, config shape, and gateway/plugin logs?
rationale: The reported symptom is real enough to keep open, but the evidence does not identify whether the broken boundary is OpenClaw core, configuration/mention gating, provider runtime, or the external WeCom plugin.

options.title: Request live trace
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for version, plugin version, redacted config shape, and gateway plus WeCom plugin logs for one mentioned group message.

options.title: Route to plugin if logs match
options.body: If new logs show WeCom plugin callbacks or streams failing before OpenClaw delivery, treat the repair as external-plugin-owned and only update OpenClaw after a fixed package is published.

options.title: Fold mention-only proof into existing issue
options.body: If reproduction shows only missing native @mention support rather than a dropped agent turn, route that evidence to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/92835.

recommendation.title: Request live trace
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and ask for version, plugin version, redacted config shape, and gateway plus WeCom plugin logs for one mentioned group message.

likelyOwner.reason: Most of the likely WeCom-specific ingress and delivery code lives in the upstream plugin runtime they introduced and maintained.
